settings.heading:
Most "best mattress"
lists are paid for.
settings.lede: So here is the specification instead. What is in it, what it costs, and what we would tell you to check on any mattress at this price, including ours.

settings.heading: Is it assembled by hand?
settings.text: Hand assembly holds the fillings in place for decades. Glue and quilting are faster and cheaper, and they settle. Ask which one, and if the answer is vague, it is glued.

settings.heading: Can the top be replaced?
settings.text: The comfort layer wears out long before the springs do. If it is sealed inside, the whole mattress goes when the top fails. Ask whether it comes off.

settings.heading: What is the guarantee actually on?
settings.text: Most guarantees cover manufacturing faults, not the softening that makes you replace it. Ask what happens in year eight, not year one.

settings.heading: Four things worth checking
settings.lede: On any mattress, at any price. Most brands will answer two of them.

settings.label: Core
settings.text: Hand-assembled pocket springs, individually housed. [X]-year guarantee on the core.

settings.label: Comfort layer
settings.text: Unzips and lifts off. Medium on one face, medium firm on the other. You do not choose a firmness - you turn it over.

settings.label: Replacement layer
settings.text: [layer] when it eventually softens. The core stays.

settings.label: Sizes
settings.text: Double through Emperor 200 x 200cm, including European King 160 x 200cm.

settings.label: Made
settings.text: To order. Nothing is held in a warehouse.

settings.heading: Our specification
settings.promise_body: Your mattress arrives with two feels in one layer - medium on one face, medium firm on the other. If neither is right, we send a complimentary comfort layer at a different tension, worth [layer]. If that still does not settle it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full.

settings.heading: Built to be kept
settings.lede: A pocket sprung core lasts decades. The top does not.
settings.body:
Every mattress you have thrown away was thrown away because of the part that wears fastest, while the springs underneath were still doing their job.

Ours comes apart. When the comfort layer eventually softens, it unzips and a new one goes on. The core stays where it is, and so does the bed you chose.

That is the whole argument for the construction. Not that it is cheaper. That you are not starting again.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is handmade to order with the same 37cm construction and the same removable comfort layer.
